verdict.rationale: GitCafe documents a REST API reference at /docs/reference/api.md, and says the same description is available as OpenAPI 3.1 JSON. Nothing in the evidence shows that reference is interactive or has runnable 'try it' examples. Probes found no OpenAPI file at the usual paths, though the docs never named those paths, so this is not a contradiction. Missing for 10: an interactive API explorer, runnable in-browser examples, a confirmed public OpenAPI spec location, and independent corroboration.
